description: Create a rule to auto-mute findings matching a pattern. Existing open findings matching the rule are muted immediately. Supports muting by fingerprint pattern, test definition, or test+target combination.

expiresAt.description: Optional expiry as ISO 8601 string. Rule auto-expires after this time.

fingerprintPattern.description: Substring to match in finding fingerprints (required for FINGERPRINT scope)

scope.description: FINGERPRINT: match by finding fingerprint substring. TEST_DEFINITION: mute all findings from a test. TEST_TARGET: mute findings from a specific test on a specific target.

targetId.description: Target ID to scope the rule to (required for TEST_TARGET, optional for others)

testDefinitionId.description: Test definition ID (required for TEST_DEFINITION and TEST_TARGET scopes)

name: create_muting_rule
title: Create Muting Rule
